text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one of my days off, I'm going around
town gathering books and
other resources
to use in Inari One's training, when...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, fancy seein' you here! Wazzup? Doin'
some shoppin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, fancy seein' you here! Wazzup? Doin'
some shoppin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya see, my old teammates are comin' for a
visit soon, so I'm lookin' for
spots to take
'em. Gotta make their trip worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But man, talk about options! Every place I
go is just as stylin' as the
last!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! You've got a good eye for stuff,
right? You got any fav
spots? Mind takin'
me to see 'em?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! You've got a good eye for stuff,
right? You got any fav
spots? Mind takin'
me to see 'em?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thanks a million! I knew I could
count on you, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thanks a million! I knew I could
count on you, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The hell's with this fancy parfait?! There's
even flowers on it... Ohhh,
is this what they
call "aesthetic"?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Everyone's walkin' around in their
bathing suits! And someone
over there is
dancin'... It's just like a festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a pool hall, huh? I've watched a few
games before, so let's see if
I can win in
one shot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this place is pretty stylish too.
...Oh,
whazzat over there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Be right back, I'm gonna go check this out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Always careful to let me know where she's
going, Inari One heads
further into the
store. She's so considerate of others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her Oi teammates coming to town,
perhaps this will be a chance
for her to let
her hair down and relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Inari One takes a look around, I
decide to browse the shop
myself...

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I told you, it was broken when I got home!
Can't you just let me
exchange it?

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
But sir, it wasn't broken when we wrapped
it up for you to take home.
Um... is it
possible you bumped it on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when I happen upon a very heated
discussion at the shop
register. The
customer looks like he wants to grab the
poor employee
by the throat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As much as I want to help the employee, I
need to make sure she
won't get caught up
in any... altercations. But seeing as she's
out of
sight, I decide to come to his aid.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! The hell are you?! Mind your own
business and scram! Or
maybe... you wanna
take this schmuck's place and—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho there, big guy! Gotta say, I like
your spunk! Ya look like
you're ready to
trade punches!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as the man turns his anger on me, a
tiny figure enters the scene.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you got some complaints. But
ya know what they say...
Actions speak
louder than words! C'mon, I say you settle
this the
old-fashioned way!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the loser can't go cryin' home to
Mommy, got it? Now, whatcha
thinkin'? A
foot race? Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: W-wait, are you suggesting we fight?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What, ya worried or somethin'? Don't
sweat it, I'll be your ref! I'll
make sure you
settle this fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not looking for a fight. I just—ah,
urgh... Guess I did lose my
temper there...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzat so? Guess I'll have to wait to ref a
street brawl! Sorry for
misunderstandin'.
You'll forgive me, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The customer looks stunned as Inari One
flashes a grin his way. He
takes a deep
breath before continuing... It looks like
he's finally
calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
...Um, my bad. I bought this as a gift for
my girlfriend, you see. Seeing
it all busted
up just set me off.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I owe you all an apology... Sorry. And,
miss... thanks for stopping me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Boss, puttin' yourself in the middle
of that spat sure took guts!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Boss, puttin' yourself in the middle
of that spat sure took guts!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya coulda just ignored 'em, but ya did the
right thing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon, you're embarrassin' me! Hehe,
not that I mind hearin' that
from you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Inari One hadn't stepped in, things
might have gotten ugly fast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, the man calmed down, but when I
think about what could
have happened if
things had taken a wrong turn...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? Why're you starin' like
that? There something on my
face?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who got us into trouble this
time, but I do want to avoid
putting her in
danger as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I was wondering why you looked so
serious...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But you're talkin' to THE Inari One! And that should be my line!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice, ya know that, Boss? I get
wantin' to help, but ya
didn't have to do it
alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice, ya know that, Boss? I get
wantin' to help, but ya
didn't have to do it
alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're thinkin' 'bout what woulda
happened if that guy tried fightin'
me,
right? Well, my chances in a fight are a lot
better than yours.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm an Umamusume, ya know! I
woulda knocked that punk into
next week!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When you were lost, you had me help you
out, right? And today, you
helped me out
by showin' me around.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm only sayin' this one more time, so listen
up—You don't gotta do
stuff alone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If ya can, why not ask an expert for their
assistance? There's a right
tool for every
job, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, ya don't gotta be so serious...
Ah,
looks like the sun's callin' it a day. We
should do the same!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, ya don't gotta be so serious...
Ah,
looks like the sun's callin' it a day. We
should do the same!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I get that you're as earnest as they come,
Boss. Trust me, I know
better than
anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I get that you're as earnest as they come,
Boss. Trust me, I know
better than
anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(But wow, that attitude sure did get you in
trouble today! Hehe, I
better keep my eye
on you, or else!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya know, I think I'll tell the Oi girls about
today! Let 'em know ya
gave me a personal
tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One smiles as she gives me a few
more pats on the back.
